skill.summary: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — trim the silent parts, add captions, and export as MP4 — and get polished...

latestVersion.changelog:
AI Video Helper 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Instantly edit and export videos by simply describing your desired edits (e.g. trim silence, add captions).
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, and WebM uploads up to 500MB; automatic AI processing on cloud GPUs.
- One-step workflow: upload, give instructions, and receive edited clips in 1–2 minutes.
- Handles credits, job status, and export directly via a chat interface—no technical setup needed.
- Session management and error handling improve reliability and clarity for new users.
- Designed for creators and marketers who want quick, professional-quality edits without complex software.
